title: Masjid rows from above
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Salah and praying in congregation
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y4 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: masjid rows from above)
intro: Lesson 9: Praying in congregation: the imam and straight rows. To understand how Muslims pray together in jama'ah and why it is worth so much more reward

questions.q: Explain how to pray behind an imam.
questions.a: Stand in a straight row, follow his movements after him, say Amin after al-Fatihah, end with salam after him.
questions.model: Point: we follow the imam. Evidence: 'The imam is appointed to be followed' (Bukhari and Muslim). Explain: we move after him, never before, and keep the row straight.

questions.q: Jama'ah prayer is how many times better?
On the pupil PDF, draw the rows of a masjid from above using squares for places (no people) and write three rules for praying in jama'ah.
questions.a: Straight rows filled from the front, follow the imam, no gaps
questions.model: Teacher draws one square for the imam's place and a straight line of squares behind it: 'Row 1 fills first.'

questions.q: pray one salah in jama'ah at home with your family this week.
how does praying in rows show that all Muslims are equal?
questions.a: Rich and poor stand side by side before Allah

questions.q: The one who leads the prayer is the ...
Back to our ponder: why is jama'ah worth more?
questions.a: Allah loves unity; it is twenty-seven times better
